coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available, so trial registries, preprint servers, regulatory sources, patent databases, dedicated citation graphs, and DOI metadata services cannot be searched directly.
PubMed alone may incompletely recover forward citations, very recent unindexed findings, variant annotations from dedicated genetics databases, and unpublished null results.
Author and terminology expansion within PubMed is an imperfect substitute for systematic backward and forward citation-graph traversal.
Non-English full texts without adequate English metadata may remain unevaluable.
exclusion_criteria: Records lacking a substantive connection to both LRRK2 biology and Parkinson disease or a directly relevant mechanistic intermediate.
Purely computational substrate, docking, or pathogenicity predictions without experimental or human genetic validation.
Studies mentioning LRRK2 only as an incidental marker without variant-level, enzymatic, substrate, pathway, or phenotype evidence.
Conference abstracts, editorials, news items, and narrative opinions without independently assessable data, except when used solely to locate primary evidence.
Duplicate publications of the same study population or experiment, while preserving all query-to-record links and retaining the most complete report.
Publications after 2024-12-31 and records whose effective publication date cannot be reconciled with the cutoff.
inclusion_criteria: Publication date on or before 2024-12-31, with ambiguous online-first and issue dates resolved during screening.
Primary human genetic studies that report linkage, segregation, association, ancestry, penetrance, or variant-level clinical evidence for LRRK2 and Parkinson disease.
Primary biochemical, structural, cellular, animal, or human-tissue studies that directly test LRRK2 enzymatic activity, substrates, pathway consequences, or disease mechanisms.
Systematic reviews and high-quality mechanistic reviews retained for terminology, historical orientation, and citation expansion, with pivotal claims verified against primary records.
Negative, null, conflicting, replication, correction, and retraction records retained when they affect the strength or generality of a mechanistic conclusion.
Non-English publications retained when an English title or abstract provides enough information for eligibility assessment, with translation needs recorded.

queries.purpose: Recover the 2004 linkage and mutation-discovery anchor studies and verify the historical aliases PARK8 and dardarin.
queries.query: ((Paisan-Ruiz C[Author] OR Zimprich A[Author]) AND (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: determine how genetic discovery and disease-associated LRRK2 variants connect altered kinase/GTPase function and physiological substrate phosphorylation to Parkinson disease, while testing penetrance, population, model, tissue, and conflicting-evidence limits. Scope covers PubMed-indexed peer-reviewed human genetic, biochemical, cellular, animal-model, neuropathological, and synthesis literature from database inception through 2024-12-31, without language restriction when an English title or abstract permits screening.
stop_rules: Complete all twelve planned PubMed query events and preserve each exact query, execution date, result count, and query-to-record link.
The sentinel wave must recover the Paisan-Ruiz and Zimprich genetic-discovery anchors; missing anchors trigger alias expansion and rerunning the affected query within the twelve-event budget.
Require direct evidence coverage for genetic discovery, major pathogenic and risk variants, enzymatic mechanism, physiological substrates, cellular consequences, and limiting or conflicting evidence.
Stop expansion after two consecutive screened expansion passes add no new decision-relevant mechanism, substrate, variant, or limitation evidence.
Stop when additional PubMed retrieval cannot change the mechanistic brief's graded conclusions, while documenting unresolved disagreements and evidence-thin concept blocks.
If the twelve-query budget is exhausted before coverage conditions are met, stop and report budget exhaustion plus the affected evidence domains as coverage gaps.
